---
ont:
  id: core.RuntimeRollback
  type: concept
  labels:
  - Runtime Rollback
  synonyms:
  - reversible canary
  - restoration proof
  - cleanup closure
  description: Terminates isolated candidates and proves processes, settings, caches,
    and owned scratch are restored.
  examples:
  - kill descendants and verify absence
  - compare before and after identities
  anti_examples:
  - leave an indeterminate process
